blurb: In today's digest: CoinEx to wind down after nine years, citing market downturn, Robinhood Chain and BNB Smart Chain go live on Jupiter’s Uni, and Ethena joins Circle, Chainlink and Aave among onchain firms
title: Crypto Trading Signals - September 15, 2026
top_story_headline: CoinEx to wind down after nine years, citing market downturn and rising regulatory costs
top_story_comment: [New York’s 2023 settlement](https://ag.ny.gov/press-release/2023/attorney-general-james-recovers-17-million-cryptocurrency-platform-operating) pushed CoinEx out of the US, then [CoinEx’s own MiCA notice](https://www.coinex.com/en/announcements/detail/50531444103828) ended EEA service on July 1, 2026. That jurisdictional squeeze matters more than the bear-market line: the long tail loses a spot venue, CSC and OneSwap when [all three shut down](https://x.com/coinexcom/status/2099680522758721756) on Sept. 29.
